name: workbench
description: Explicitly invoked Workbench skills for evidence briefs, decision dialogue, scoped execution, OpenAPI, visual grounding, dev wiki context, and opt-in script-source capture.

interface.shortDescription: Shape, execute, and observe scoped work.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides explicitly invoked skills for Codex: organize Jira/Figma/API/user evidence, clarify goals and completion conditions through dialogue, execute a Goal Contract with project dev wiki context, verify results, and explicitly set up opt-in collection of source snapshots for scripts Codex executes.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:brainstorm to clarify a goal and prepare a Goal Contract, then invoke $workbench:executor separately to execute it.
Use $workbench:openapi to register, inspect, or test a Swagger/OpenAPI service.
Use $workbench:llm-script to set up or inspect opt-in script-source capture for the current workspace.
